content:
[L] high | bottom edge of screen | defect: a raw debug string "sent_text=" is rendered below the composer card at the window edge, truncated and bleeding into the page background like console output.
[C] high | lower two-thirds of the window | defect: a vast empty dead zone occupies the entire area below the composer with no content, no list, no reading pane, making the screen look half-rendered.
[C] high | whole window | defect: none of the expected inbox structure exists — no views rail, no conversation list, no reading pane, no toolbar or search — only a lone composer card floating in whitespace, which reads as a debug harness, not a product.
[H] med | composer card, lower left | defect: the bare lowercase label "tools" floats unstyled between the textarea and the footer hint, with no heading weight, icon, or grouping, and its purpose is unintelligible.
[H] med | composer footer left | defect: "reply — sent to the customer · Ctrl+Enter sends" mixes status, action metadata, and keyboard hint at identical small gray weight, competing with the "Draft saved" label top-right that says nearly the same thing.
[S] med | composer card right edge vs window edge | defect: the composer card's right margin (~10px) does not match its left margin (~22px), so the card is asymmetric within the window.
[S] med | "To: kim@example.com" row | defect: the recipient line sits tight against the textarea below it with far less spacing than the divider above it, giving the card uneven internal rhythm.
[S] low | top-right control cluster | defect: "Draft saved" text nearly touches the "AI Draft" button, with a gap noticeably smaller than the spacing between the two buttons.
[H] low | textarea | defect: the draft body shows only "draft text" placeholder crammed at the very top of a tall empty box, leaving the large field visually vacant.
[S] low | Reply/Note toggle | defect: the active "Reply" pill and inactive "Note" pill sit inside a light gray container whose padding around "Reply" is larger than around "Note", making the toggle look lopsided.
[L] low | "sent_text=" line | defect: the debug text starts flush at x≈8px, breaking the composer card's left alignment and appearing clipped mid-output.

VERDICT: unprofessional — a floating composer over a debug-printed variable and two-thirds empty canvas is nowhere near shipped-product quality.

Defect-free region note: the Reply/Note toggle's internal styling is the closest thing to a designed control on screen, though still imperfectly padded.
